title: feat(fields): zero-config multi-column lookup picker + i18n
body:
## Problem

Browser-testing the showcase lookup picker surfaced that the Record Picker and quick-select popover **degrade to a single name-only column** whenever a lookup field doesn't declare explicit `lookup_columns` — which is *every* lookup in app-showcase and CRM today. Picking an Account showed only the name, with no way to disambiguate. The picker strings were also hardcoded English inside the localized (zh-CN) UI.

This is the **renderer track** of a broader lookup-UX effort (gap analysis benchmarked the picker against Salesforce / Power Apps / Mendix / SAP Fiori / ServiceNow / Airtable). Companion tracks (framework spec wiring + showcase config/seed) follow separately.

## Changes

- **`deriveLookupColumns()`** — when no `lookup_columns` are authored, derive a multi-column, disambiguating set from the *referenced object's* schema: honour its `displayFields` when present, else the display field plus the next few business fields in declaration order, skipping system/audit fields and heavy non-tabular types. Column `type` is carried through, so the picker renders currency / select-badge / date / link cells via the shared cell renderer.
- **Inline popover secondary line** — shows the first derived non-display field when no explicit `description_field` is set.
- **Filter bar auto-enabled** from the derived typed columns.
- **i18n** — localize all previously-hardcoded English picker strings via a new `lookup` namespace (en + zh added; other locales fall back to en).

## Verification

- Unit test `deriveLookupColumns.test.ts` (7 cases: ordering, label/type carry-through, system-field & non-tabular skipping, max cap, `displayFields` honouring, de-dupe).
- **Live** against app-showcase (zh-CN): the Account picker now shows **客户名称 / 行业 / 年收入 / 网站** — Industry as colored badges, Annual Revenue formatted, Website as links — instead of a single "NAME" column, fully localized (搜索…, 3 条记录, 筛选).

### Before → After
Before: one column `NAME`, `Search...`, `3 records`.
After: 4 sortable typed columns + filter bar, all in Chinese.

Note: other locale bundles fall back to English for the new `lookup.*` keys; translating them is a small follow-up.
